title: Grateful Dead Live at Shoreline Amphitheatre on 1991-05-12
source: Schoeps MK4 w/ RBox 16 Bit 48K.  Do not recall DAT use to master this show. Recorded from section 102. Transferred by Nick C using Sony D7>Edirol R-44 via coax digital. Processed using Soundforge 10b, resample, to 16bit 44.1K and split tracks TLH to convert to Flac

ai_review.summary: Outstanding new Schoeps transfer delivers crystal-clear soundboard quality, though no performance details are provided.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that this FLAC is a fresh transfer of the same Schoeps front‑of‑house source used for shnid=9402 and praises its outstanding audio fidelity. While the recording sounds superb, there’s no information on how the band performed that night.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review focusing on excellent recording quality; no data on show performance, so rating reflects strong audio but limited overall insight.

recording_quality.technical_notes: New transfer of the Schoeps FOB source; clarity and detail described as outstanding.
